{
  "entities": [
    {
      "type": "entity",
      "name": "elevenlabs-arabic-tts-patterns",
      "entityType": "technical_pattern",
      "observations": [
        "Brand names: ALWAYS use English/Latin spelling inside Arabic text for multilingual v2",
        "Comma pause trick: 'الفريق، من BrandName' forces clear pronunciation",
        "Numbers: spell out years fully in Arabic words, add currency word after amounts",
        "Warmth sweet spot: stability 0.35-0.40, style 0.35-0.40, similarity 0.70-0.80",
        "Clean audio: bump similarity to 0.80 and stability to 0.40 to reduce artifacts",
        "Speed: ALWAYS use native speed param (0.92-0.95), NEVER FFmpeg post-processing",
        "Model: eleven_multilingual_v2 is best for emotional/warm Arabic speech",
        "A/B testing: generate 3 variations of key scripts before committing to full batch"
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "entity",
      "name": "elevenlabs-voice-agent-tuning-playbook",
      "entityType": "playbook",
      "observations": [
        "CRITICAL: Never use response-by-response scripts (رد 1: X بس) — kills personality. Use situational guidelines instead.",
        "CRITICAL: Never put exact-quote examples in prompts for voice agents — LLM will parrot them verbatim. Use 'express this idea your way' pattern.",
        "Temperature sweet spot for Arabic voice agents: 0.5-0.7. Below 0.5 = robotic. Above 0.7 = incoherent.",
        "TTS stability sweet spot: 0.40-0.50. Below 0.35 = noisy artifacts. Above 0.55 = monotonous robot.",
        "Three-lever humanization: temperature + stability + prompt de-scripting. Apply all three simultaneously for best results.",
        "Arabic numbers: ALWAYS spell out (خمس مية not 500). TTS engines cannot reliably convert digits to Arabic speech.",
        "Brand names in Arabic: use English spelling (Seekapa) not Arabic (سيكابا). Arabic diacritics get swallowed by TTS.",
        "Webhook tool JSON parsing: add explicit 'read the price field' instruction in BOTH tool description AND prompt. LLMs hallucinate prices otherwise.",
        "After PATCH update: wait 30-60 seconds before testing. ElevenLabs propagation is not instant.",
        "reasoning_effort: not supported for gpt-5-mini or claude-sonnet-4-5 in ElevenLabs. Set to null.",
        "max_tokens 150 is good ceiling for Arabic conversation — prevents info-dumping while allowing complete thoughts.",
        "Info-dump prevention: add 'لا تجمع كل المعلومات برد واحد' to prompt."
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "entity",
      "name": "ux-ui-design-learnings",
      "entityType": "design_knowledge",
      "observations": [
        "2026-02-02: Code-based React/TS prototypes beat static mockups for design assignments — evaluators can interact, iteration is faster, AI writes code faster than pixel-pushing",
        "2026-02-02: Reviewer feedback maps directly to code changes — each feedback point becomes a specific file:line edit. Code-as-design enables rapid iteration loops.",
        "2026-02-02: Subtle card separation (bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-100) preferred over heavy borders or plain dividers for list items",
        "2026-02-02: Typography hierarchy must be disciplined — section titles: text-base font-semibold, item titles: text-sm font-normal, metadata: text-xs text-secondary",
        "2026-02-02: Icons should be minimal neutral base with soft color HINTS (muted: #9CA3AF, #A3B8CC, #9CB5A8) — not saturated colors, not all gray",
        "2026-02-02: AI insights/explanations must be PROXIMATE to the content they reference — inline under summary banners, not floating at bottom",
        "2026-02-02: Selection UX requires consistency — either all selected by default OR none. Never mixed. Always include Select All for bulk actions.",
        "2026-02-02: Soft abstract illustrations at top of content areas create emotional warmth without distraction — use opacity-70, max h-[100px], centered",
        "2026-02-02: Decorative visual indicators (colored lines, borders) must have clear meaning or be removed — reviewers flag meaningless ornamentation",
        "2026-02-02: Scrollbar should only appear when content overflows — use overflow-y-auto with scrollbar-gutter: auto, never force-show scrollbar",
        "2026-02-02: Consistent layout shell (same header + left nav) across ALL screens builds trust and professional feel",
        "2026-02-02: Font consistency is non-negotiable — same family (Montserrat), same size scale, same weights across all screens including AI creation and input fields",
        "2026-02-02: Parallel code-worker agents (6 agents for 12 fixes) work for independent UI changes — no merge conflicts when changes are in separate components",
        "2026-02-02: Playwright screenshot + Gemini Vision audit is the definitive visual validation pipeline — scores of 95-98 confirm production quality"
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "entity",
      "name": "ux-ui-design-anti-patterns",
      "entityType": "design_knowledge",
      "observations": [
        "2026-02-02: NEVER describe UI when you can show it — Or Project 2 first attempt failed because it was text-only. The research was excellent but zero visuals = fail.",
        "2026-02-02: NEVER use heavy borders or strong card styling for list items — reviewer explicitly requested 'light shadow if it improves clarity, no strong borders'",
        "2026-02-02: NEVER add decorative colored lines without clear meaning — vertical colored lines on unchanged items confuse users",
        "2026-02-02: NEVER place AI explanations far from their content — bottom-of-page explanations are ignored. Inline them.",
        "2026-02-02: NEVER use mixed selection states — some items checked, others not creates confusion. Pick one default.",
        "2026-02-02: NEVER use inconsistent typography across screens — different fonts between AI creation and content screens breaks professional feel",
        "2026-02-02: NEVER show scrollbar when content fits — unnecessary scrollbar is visual noise that degrades perceived quality"
      ]
    },

    {
      "type": "entity",
      "name": "sentimark-learnings",
      "entityType": "session_learnings",
      "observations": [
        "[2026-02-03] FAILURE: Score-threshold tier assignment breaks on clustered data (sis_scores 37-64). ALL assets got Tier 1. Fix: Use INDEX-based assignment after sorting.",
        "[2026-02-03] FAILURE: Improved-dashboard trap — better fonts on same grid layout scores 92/100 on Gemini but user rejects as same style. Visual METAPHOR must be fundamentally different.",
        "[2026-02-03] FAILURE: Gemini vision scores measure technical execution not design originality. 90+ score does NOT predict user satisfaction.",
        "[2026-02-03] SUCCESS: Research-then-implement for design — Grok+Gemini research produced genuinely different visual metaphors (skyline, starfield, mosaic) vs derivative grids.",
        "[2026-02-03] SUCCESS: Dynamic range normalization — mapping narrow score range to full visual range makes differences visible.",
        "[2026-02-03] SUCCESS: One signature interaction per concept (spotlight, column-expand, magnetic cursor) — restraint over spectacle.",
        "[2026-02-03] SUCCESS: Font infrastructure reuse — set up Instrument Serif, Bricolage Grotesque, JetBrains Mono once, reuse across 3 rounds.",
        "[2026-02-03] DECISION: Asset page concepts use 3 fundamentally different visual metaphors: Living Grid (editorial mosaic), Conviction Horizon (city skyline), Neural Constellation (starfield scatter).",

        "[2026-02-04] FINDING: Confidence dampening (x0.4) + epistemic bonus system produces avg 0.22 confidence that is useless for filtering quality predictions.",
        "[2026-02-04] FINDING: V3 abstention thresholds too aggressive — signal_strength neutral_band filters out 65.9% of predictions, z_score k filters another 6.6%.",
        "[2026-02-04] FINDING: Only 24h horizon has been evaluated. 7d and 30d predictions still pending evaluation. Cannot assess multi-horizon performance yet.",

        "[2026-02-09] SUCCESS: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 fixes cryptic ENOENT pages-manifest.json (actually OOM)",
        "[2026-02-09] DISCOVERY: Perplexity sonar-reasoning-pro rejects search_recency_filter → 60% failures. Standard sonar-pro works.",
        "[2026-02-09] llm_prediction.py:1479 still sends search_recency_filter in _perplexity_extract_features — needs cleanup",
        "[2026-02-11] Success: Evening Eval Architecture as reusable blueprint — 5-phase structure with pre-defined hypotheses prevented cherry-picking",

        "[2026-02-11] Failure: V3 consensus key mismatch existed for entire gate lifetime (8,475 decisions) undetected",

        "[2026-02-11] Failure: Intelligence scores exist in asset_profile but pred dict architecture doesn't thread them to gate",
        "[2026-02-12] SUCCESS: Plan-first multi-bug diagnosis — reading all 6 bugs before editing any code prevented cascading partial fixes and enabled priority triage (P0/P1/P2)",

        "[2026-02-16] Success: SQL before/after window comparison for deploy verification — aggregate distribution over 100+ predictions reveals systematic changes (pattern-076)",
        "[2026-02-16] Success: Schema column discovery via information_schema before any session queries — gate_monitoring_log has NO symbol column, virtual_portfolios uses portfolio_name not name (pattern-077)",
        "[2026-02-16] Failure: Read tool line number prefixes corrupt base64 data — use Bash cat for raw binary files (anti-067)",

        "[2026-02-16] DB Schema: gate_monitoring_log has NO symbol column (join via prediction_history). virtual_portfolio_positions uses asset_symbol + virtual_portfolio_id. virtual_portfolios uses portfolio_name.",
        "[2026-02-16] CRITICAL: Sentimark API returns accuracy as 0-100 percentages, NOT 0-1 decimals. Frontend must NOT multiply by 100. Caught via live Playwright screenshot showing 3440% instead of 34.4%.",

        "[2026-02-04] SUCCESS: Raw Responses API + type:function tools bypasses broken type:openapi tools completely. Full function-call loop proven: model returns function_call → execute CRM HTTP → send function_call_output → repeat until text message.",
